design_gotchas.title: Classic LM358DR / LMV358IDR Identical SOIC-8 Pinout Trap (Missing Pull-Up & Oscillation)
design_gotchas.detail: LM393DR shares the exact same 8-pin SOIC pinout as dual op-amps LM358DR and LMV358IDR, but is an uncompensated open-collector voltage comparator—NOT an op-amp. Populating LM393DR on an LM358/LMV358 PCB yields a floating high output (no pull-up resistor) and severe oscillation under linear negative feedback.

design_gotchas.title: Mandatory External Pull-Up Resistor for Open-Collector Outputs
design_gotchas.detail: Pins 1 (1OUT) and 7 (2OUT) only pull low via an NPN transistor (IOL ≥ 6 mA at VOL = 1.5 V; 20 mA abs max). An external pull-up resistor to any logic rail up to 36 V is mandatory for logic-high states and governs the rising-edge RC time constant.

design_gotchas.title: Negative Input Below -0.3 V Causes Output Inversion via Parasitic Substrate Diode
design_gotchas.detail: Valid common-mode input range is 0 V to VCC - 2.0 V over temperature (only one input must stay in-range for valid logic state). Driving either input below -0.3 V forward-biases parasitic diodes, raising ICC and potentially inverting the output state.

design_gotchas.title: Commercial 0°C to 70°C Rating and Non-B Specs vs LM393BDR Upgrade
design_gotchas.detail: Legacy LM393DR is rated only 0°C to 70°C, 30 V max operating supply, 1.3 µs typ response time, and 25 nA typ IB. For industrial temperatures (-40°C to +85°C) or 36 V operation, TI offers the drop-in LM393BDR (1.0 µs, 3.5 nA IB, 200 µA/ch).

typical_use_cases: Overvoltage, undervoltage, and window-comparator fault supervisors on 2 V–30 V rails
Wired-AND multi-channel fault/power-good logic buses using open-collector outputs
Level-shifted threshold detection from 12 V/24 V analog sensors to 3.3 V/5 V MCU GPIOs
Zero-crossing detectors, relaxation oscillators, and hysteresis Schmitt triggers
engineering_summary: The Texas Instruments LM393DR is the industry-standard dual open-collector voltage comparator in an 8-pin SOIC (D) package operating from 2 V to 30 V (36 V abs max) over 0°C to 70°C. It provides ground-sensing PNP Darlington inputs, 1.3 µs typical response time (300 ns for TTL steps), 5 mV max offset, and 225 µA/ch typical quiescent current (0.45 mA total at 5 V). Despite sharing an identical SOIC-8 pinout with dual op-amps LM358DR and LMV358IDR, LM393DR is NOT interchangeable with op-amps: its uncompensated open-collector outputs require external pull-up resistors and cannot operate stably in linear negative-feedback amplifier circuits.
